name: Quinoa Tabbouleh Salad with Tomato, Parsley & Mint

instructions.primary_message: In a medium saucepan, combine quinoa, water, and salt; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup quinoa
2 cup water
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lemons
3 tomatoes
3 small bunches Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
1 small pkg fresh mint

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into a large bowl.
Peel and mince shallots. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice along with oil and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 shallots
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp coriander, ground
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Small dice tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Pick mint leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl, stir to combine, and set aside.

When the quinoa is done, transfer to a large baking sheet pan. Spread out in an even layer and let cool for 5 minutes. Once cool, add to the bowl with the other ingredients and stir to combine the tabbouleh.
To serve, divide tabbouleh between plates or bowls and enjoy!
